Sections.title: Eco Clubs
descriptions: College eco-clubs will encourage students to engage in important environmental projects and activities. It is a platform where students may interact with, engage, and influence their parents and local communities to support ethical environmental behavior. It will enable students to delve further into environmental ideas and initiatives outside the bounds of a syllabus or curriculum. Although “learning to live sustainably” is emphasized by everyone, everywhere, the environment is still only a minor concern in the formal educational system.

Sections.title: Our Vision
descriptions: Our mission is to raise public awareness about social and environmental sustainability. Along with that, we also want to instil sustainable behaviours in everyone who belongs to institutions, including its scholars, students, and other stakeholders.

Sections.title: Our Mission
descriptions: To instill a feeling of sustainable habits and practices, we educate and inspire lives.
